name: devbook
description: Devbook's opt-in domain skills: the ones with no maintained vendor equivalent. Install only the ones a project needs.

plugins.name: api-design
plugins.description: Adds or changes REST endpoints: contract first, problem-details errors, pagination, idempotency, ETags and webhooks.

plugins.name: db-migration
plugins.description: Plans and writes safe relational schema changes: constraints, indexes and expand-migrate-contract across deploys.

plugins.name: feature-doc
plugins.description: Writes and maintains FEATURE.md docs with EARS rules, flow and a file map, and only when a feature needs one.

plugins.name: licensing
plugins.description: Checks licences of dependencies, assets and copied code with SPDX identifiers; a human chooses the project licence.

plugins.name: llm-security
plugins.description: Secures features that call a language model: untrusted input and output, enforced permissions, minimal data and caps.
